sourceRules.basicText: Wiglaf deals 1 damage to each adjacent fighter. If Beowulf was dealt damage this way, gain 1 action.

sourceRules.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

sourceRules.duringText: This card's value is +1 for each Rage you have. (You do not spend Rage for this effect.)

sourceRules.basicText: This card's effects cannot be canceled.
sourceRules.duringText: You may spend 2 Rage to make this card's value 5 instead. You may spend 1 Rage to BOOST this card. (You may do both.)

sourceRules.afterText: If you attacked a sidekick and won the combat, you may spend 3 Rage to defeat that sidekick.

sourceRules.duringText: Spend any amount of Rage. This card's value is +2 for each Rage spent.

sourceRules.immediateText: You may spend 2 Rage to deal damage to the opposing fighter equal to the printed value of their card.

sourceRules.basicText: Choose an opponent. They discard 1 random card. Gain rage equal to its BOOST value.
Spend any amount of Rage. Choose a different effect for each Rage spent: - draw 2 cards - move Beowulf up to 4 spaces - Beowulf recovers 2 health.

sourceRules.afterText: Wiglaf may swap spaces with Beowulf.
If you won the combat, draw 2 cards. If you lost the combat, your opponent draws 2 cards.
If you won the combat, choose one of the fighters in the combat and move them up to 2 spaces.
